concept: Grounded, established accounting identity for White Oak Tax Solutions. A deep forest-green primary signals stability and growth, paired with a warm bronze/gold accent that reads as credible and traditional. Charcoal-green ink on warm off-white backgrounds keeps the palette professional and easy to read, evoking the steadiness of a long-trusted DeKalb firm.
